remainingGaps: The collector guide does not provide an exhaustive numbered base, autograph or insert parallel ladder. Card-specific chase examples must not assign limits to every card or unrelated family.
No regular Chrome numbering or format specification is copied to the separate Sapphire release.
The numbered PDF retains an unlabelled additional column containing artist names or comic years in four programs; these are not teams, rookie flags or product release years.
The PDF's Characters II cards 136 Mary Jane and 137 Misery share one physical line. Both numbers are printed; their cells are retained separately without deriving an ID from sequence.
